"Create an AI-powered matching system for Intern Us that intelligently connects students with internship opportunities based on skills, interests, location, career goals, and company culture fit. The system should use machine learning to improve matches over time and provide match confidence scores with explanations."
Build user profile collection system with skills taxonomy and interest mapping
Create internship opportunity database with structured company profiles and requirements
Integrate AI matching algorithm using cosine similarity or vector embeddings
Build match confidence scoring system with explanations (why this match?)
Create feedback loop to improve matching algorithm based on user actions
Design match results UI with filtering and sorting options
Lovable.dev (Gemini 2.5 Pro for complex matching) + Firebase Studio (scalable database)

"Build an AI career advisor chatbot for Intern Us that provides personalized career guidance based on user profiles, interests, skills, and labor market data. The advisor should offer actionable recommendations for skill development, career paths, and internship strategies tailored to South African youth."
Design conversational AI interface with natural language understanding
Integrate career database with South African labor market insights
Create personalized career path recommendation engine
Build skills gap analysis tool with learning resource recommendations
Add conversation memory to track user progress over time
Design mobile-friendly chat UI with voice input option
Lovable.dev (GPT-5 Mini for conversational depth) + integrate with real career data APIs

"Develop an AI-powered CV builder and interview simulator for Intern Us that helps students create professional resumes and practice interviews with realistic AI feedback. Include industry-specific CV templates, ATS optimization, and video interview practice with sentiment analysis and improvement suggestions."
Create guided CV builder with industry-specific templates
Build AI content suggestion engine for CV sections (achievements, skills, etc.)
Integrate ATS optimization scanner with improvement suggestions
Create interview question bank by industry and role
Build AI interview simulator with voice/video recording
Add sentiment analysis and delivery feedback (pace, confidence, clarity)
Generate personalized improvement reports after practice sessions
Lovable.dev (Gemini 2.5 Flash for content + sentiment) or Bubble.io (complex workflow)

"Build a comprehensive internship management system for Intern Us that tracks the full internship lifecycle: discovery, application, placement, monitoring, and completion. Include dashboards for students, companies, and administrators with automated notifications and progress tracking."
Create internship listing database with search and filtering
Build application workflow with status tracking (applied, interview, offer, etc.)
Design student dashboard showing active applications and recommendations
Create company portal for posting opportunities and reviewing applicants
Build admin dashboard with analytics and reporting tools
Integrate automated email/SMS notifications for status changes
Bubble.io (complex workflows + database) or Firebase Studio (scalability)

"Rebuild Intern Us website with mobile-first responsive design optimized for South African connectivity conditions. Include offline capabilities for core features like viewing saved internships, accessing resources, and reading career guidance content when internet is unavailable."
Design mobile-first responsive layouts for all pages
Add service workers for offline caching of key content
Optimize images and assets for low-bandwidth connections
Create offline fallback UI with sync notifications
Webflow (design control) or Wix Studio (fast responsive automation)

"Add gamification system to Intern Us that rewards users for completing profile sections, applying to internships, finishing courses, and engaging with the community. Include points, badges, leaderboards, and a rewards marketplace where students can redeem achievements for real benefits."
Design points system with action-based earning (profile completion, applications, etc.)
Create achievement badge library with unlock conditions
Build leaderboard system (weekly, monthly, all-time) by category
Create rewards marketplace with partner offers and benefits
Add progress tracking dashboard showing user stats and next milestones
Bubble.io (complex point tracking) or Wix Studio (simpler visual badges)

"Create an AI-powered virtual companion chatbot for Intern Us that provides 24/7 support to students. Build knowledge base from existing FAQ and support content
